svg.text: Emilia | THREE DISTINCT HYPOTHESES, NO SELECTED WINNER
A study of unobserved surface variables, not three scales of one oval. All drawings are synthetic.
Earlier fullness / steeper medial-to-outer curvature / long upper-to-lower taper
Broader anterior distribution / wide turning zone / longer fullest span
Later onset / lower anterior breadth / gentle medial bridge / retained sidewall
Distinctness is a design check, not evidence. The original frames do not choose among these hidden forms.
Candidate C explores a gentle connected medial bridge, not two attached objects or a deep central depression.
The full A-E sections and complete contour drawings appear on each candidate sheet. No geometry test is authorized.
